newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian central bank raises overnight rates.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian central bank raises overnight rates.

text.p: Indonesia's central bank, Bank Indonesia, on Thursday raised overnight rates for short-term papers (SBIs) to 14.0 percent from 13.0 percent, dealers said.
One dealer said the central bank had raised its interest rates for overnight bilateral papers by one percentage point for Thursday while keeping other rates unchanged.

The bank offered overnight SBIs at 14.0 percent, four-to-six day at 12.0 percent, one-week at eight percent, two-week at 8.5 percent, one-month at 10.5, three at 11.0, six at 11.625 and one-year at 12.25 percent.
